scientific_integrity: Algebraic proof and exact rational witness; numerical bisection is descriptive only. Closely related mathematical priority remains provisional. Not independently validated.
scientific_limitations: Conditional exponential transmission model, not a calibration to any measured riverbed; no fragmentation, aggregation, remobilization, new inputs, depth-dependent rates, or measurement noise. The example uses hypothetical nonmonotone rates despite monotone trends in the motivating homogeneous-column study.
title: A sharp two-reversal law for single-peaked four-class filtration
